findings: The Remark (l.134-138) prints « si » (interior points ⇒ one facette), but Prop. 1's proof (l.146-149, « Or, cela résulte de la remarque ci-dessus ») uses the converse (A ∈ F ⇒ A interior to l ∩ F). The converse is true (interieur_of_fw, fw_iff_interieur_moduleTopology), so the Remark holds as « si et seulement si », as its wording « On peut donner de la définition de F_W(A,B) l'énoncé suivant » intends; nothing is wrong, the « si » is a definitional « si ».
questions: « n points ... appartiennent à une même facette » is read as F_W pairwise (∀ i j, F_W(A_i, A_j)); for n ≥ 1 this is equivalent to membership in one facette (pairwise_fw_iff_exists_facette); for n = 0 the pairwise form is vacuous while « une même facette » would require W ≠ ∅.

Benzecri.affineSpan_Ioo01: the support of ]0,1[ is the whole line
kb_proposals: Chapter3/Facettes: work with α(W) through alphaW_iff_extend (A + ε(A − B) ∈ W, ε > 0) and the submodule dirW of two-sided directions at a point; exists_uniform_isDirW gives a common bound for finitely many directions. Later Ch. 3 targets (variétés d'appui, Prop. 1) should import this module, not redefine facettes.

A topology-free 'interior in the finite-dimensional linear variety L' over a bare vector space: put moduleTopology ℝ on the direction (haveI : IsModuleTopology ℝ V := ⟨rfl⟩) and use IsModuleTopology.isOpenMap_of_surjective from (Fin n → ℝ); no T2 or topology on E is needed (fw_iff_interieur_moduleTopology).
Mathlib's openSegment_same (openSegment x x = {x}) is exactly Benzécri's convention )A, A( = {A} of Ch. 3 § 1.
